freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or global TLS disablement used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Yueyang City Real Estate Registration Center page exposes a public 地籍图查询 (cadastral map query) section and links to the Hunan public query portal. The page itself contains no parcel feature response.

Official Miluo government report states that the Miluo Natural Resources Bureau operates a land-space information platform and real-estate registration platform. This establishes local institutional custody, not open vector access.
Official linked Hunan real-estate public-query route; bounded anonymous GET timed out before HTML, JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, or API could be inspected.

requests.assessment: Official cadastral-map query landing page loaded; source HTML exposes only the linked portal, not parcel geometry or an API response.
TLS-verified bounded request timed out after 20 seconds; not evidence of cadastral absence and no retry/bypass attempted.
Official homepage fetch timed out in the web reader; search indexing and the official Miluo report supplied the custody evidence. Not evidence of absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Miluo City local natural-resources and real-estate registration administration under Yueyang, China.
